evals.prompt: We run an ADHD franchise and want a prescription digital therapeutic we can offer to children in the US. Lay out the options and what the record shows.
evals.expected_output: Writes the opportunity back in the person's words; proposed WHO axis (SP-056) and Oslo product innovation (SP-038), labeled proposed; TRL not proposed because the state of the technology is not given. Longlist: business as usual (SP-093, labeled UK public-sector guidance), build, co-develop, in-license, and any added option labeled proposed; no preferred option. Akili Interactive Labs, Inc. from the saved build_company_profile (retrieved 19 October 2026): EndeavorRx De Novo granted 15 June 2020 (DEN200026, 'DENG' written in words), 510(k) cleared 13 December 2023 (K231337); EndeavorOTC 510(k) cleared 14 June 2024 (K233496); product code QFT; 10 registered studies, 3 linked by brand; evidence maturity 100 rubric v1 as a library convention; two Form D rows with 'no valuation or investor names' (DL-016; DL-018, inference); never 'approved'. Treats the acquisition remark as a press claim from the person, then answers it from the record: Akili 8-K, 29 May 2024, merger agreement with Virtual Therapeutics Corporation (SP-150 [WF]); Akili 8-K, 2 July 2024, Items 2.01 and 5.01, offer completed and Akili a wholly owned subsidiary of Virtual Therapeutics Corporation (SP-151 [WF]); Form 25-NSE 2 July 2024 (SP-153 [WF]) and Form 15-12G 12 July 2024 (SP-154 [WF]); corrects 'last year' to 2 July 2024; says Form 25 concerns the listing only (DL-144) and Form 15 is not dissolution (DL-149, inference). States EndeavorRx's current FDA listing holder (Akili Interactive Labs c/o Virtual Therapeutics, SP-168) separately from the De Novo requester (SP-166), and that the listing holder is not proof of who can license. Notes the profile's CIK 0001741200 differs from the listed parent Akili, Inc., CIK 1850266 (SP-148). In the Answer paragraph names the option the status blocks: the in-license option cannot be scored on counterparty terms until the person confirms the licensor's legal entity; Virtual Therapeutics status [GAP]: not read; no Akili filing will disclose a future license. Licensing facts for the US (DOJ/FTC guidelines 12 January 2017, 20% safety zone, SP-143 to SP-147) with the threshold beside 'your share: not given', flagged for the legal owner the person names or owner not named; no 'exempt'. Gaps by reason. Record line is the very last line: 'Clears it: ... owner not named ... verify.build_record ... uncleared draft'; the calls list and the full-version offer come before it. Every fact cites its source name and date in plain words with the row id after it. Short mode at or under 450 words, checked with scripts/options_check.py words.

evals.prompt: Our board wants a probability of success for our digital therapeutic program.
